Qwen-Agent is a framework for developing LLM applications based on the instruction following, tool usage, planning, and memory capabilities of Qwen. It also comes with example applications such as Browser Assistant, Code Interpreter, and Custom Assistant. Now Qwen-Agent plays as the backend of [Qwen Chat](https://chat.qwen.ai/). # News * ð¥ð¥ð¥Feb 16, 2026: Open-sourced Qwen3.5. For usage examples, refer to [Qwen3.5 Agent Demo](./examples/assistant_qwen3.5.py). * Jan 27, 2026: Open-sourced agent evaluation benchmark [DeepPlanning](https://qwenlm.github.io/Qwen-Agent/en/benchmarks/deepplanning/) and added Qwen-Agent [documentation](https://qwenlm.github.io/Qwen-Agent/en/guide/). * Sep 23, 2025: Added [Qwen3-VL Tool-call Demo](./examples/cookbook_think_with_images.ipynb), supporting tools such as zoom in, image search, and web search. * Jul 23, 2025: Add [Qwen3-Coder Tool-call Demo](./examples/assistant_qwen3_coder.py); Added native API tool call interface support, such as using vLLM's built-in tool call parsing. * May 1, 2025: Add [Qwen3 Tool-call Demo](./examples/assistant_qwen3.py), and add [MCP Cookbooks](./examples/). * Mar 18, 2025: Support for the `reasoning_content` field; adjust the default [Function Call template](./qwen_agent/llm/fncall_prompts/nous_fncall_prompt.py), which is applicable to the Qwen2.5 series general models and QwQ-32B.
